implementation.status_families: Worker HTTP 401/402/403 map to provider-configuration, 400/422 retain the sanitized client-rejection family, and 408/429/5xx retain provider-unavailable.
implementation.source_free_mapping: The source-free harness maps 400/401/402/403/422 to ProviderConfiguration while preserving source-free evidence.
implementation.sampling: Injected temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, and frequency_penalty are rejected by final-wire validation before transport.
implementation.privacy: Only bounded sanitized diagnostics are retained; no raw request, raw response, source, reasoning, or unsupported provider retention claim is added.
implementation.unchanged: The provider health probe, probe driver, durable no-tools probe behavior, provider retry policy, schema, migration, source scope, and system configuration remain unchanged.

network: No live provider, source-bearing request, database, network, credential, host setting, or system configuration was accessed or changed.
warnings: Existing NU1507 and EF assembly-version warnings remain; the only skipped tests are the two opt-in live-provider qualifications.
